content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (§ 22.1).**

- **Issue:** § 22.1 let Vendor "audit Customer at any time without notice" with remote access to our systems — that is the playbook walk-away position (unlimited/unannounced audits plus system access).
- **Rest of the section is fine:** § 22.2 already puts cost on Vendor unless underpayment exceeds 5% and bars direct system access; § 22.3 makes findings our Confidential Information. § 23 adds no separate records-inspection right, so no further edits were needed.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** rewrote § 22.1 to once per 12 months, 30 days' prior written notice, normal business hours, non-disruptive, independent non-competitor auditor bound by confidentiality, records-only review conducted off-site, with no direct or remote system access. Comment flags 15 days' notice as an available fallback.
